correctness.rationale: The full automorphism group follows from connectedness of the double cover, the Petersen adjacency identity A²=2I−A+J, its invertibility, and the five maximal stars of size four. In a separate reproduction, /workspace/reproductions/desargues_chains.py enumerates independent faces by choosing the two layers separately, obtains ranks (1,19,141,519,991,932,383,97,18,2) by sparse elimination in characteristics 2 and 3, and checks the signed alternating trace directly for all 240 actions. The mod-2 ranks bound rational Betti numbers above; Euler gives β5=β4+4. If H4 vanished, transpositions would act trivially on H5 since their trace would be its full dimension, contradicting the 3-cycle trace. The same trace test excludes the trivial S5 character on the now one-dimensional H4. Subtracting the alternating trace gives the point-permutation character on H5. A positive deck sign on H4 would force a positive deck eigenspace on H5 with character sgn, absent from the permutation module. This proves both negative deck signs. After barycentric subdivision rational orbit-space cochains identify by pullback with invariant cochains, and invariants are exact. The resulting groups support no products of positive-degree classes. The replay checks finite chain data, not the character-identification or quotient arguments, which are analytic.
